name: The Dispatch
description: Newsprint-style site for an independent weekly newsletter with free and paid tiers, decoding headlines and an issue stack that fans out.
features: Broadsheet masthead with dateline bar, ticker and in-this-issue contents
Email signup form plus Reader, Member and Founding subscription tiers
Latest-issue cards that fan out from a paper stack as you scroll
Newsroom masthead, letters to the editor, FAQ and a write-to-the-desk form
signature: Headlines decode from scrambled type; latest-issue cards fan out like a stack of papers on scroll
